question: What is the minimum age requirement to be elected as President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __35 years__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The President of India is the first citizen of India and the executive head of the state.
 
• He/She is elected by the electoral college consisting of the elected members of both the houses of parliament and that of the state legislative assemblies.
 
• A person should 
 
 
• be a citizen of India;
 
• be of 35 years of age, and
 
• must not hold the office of profit to be elected as the President of India.
 
 
 
• **The term of the President is 5 years but there is no upper limit on the times a person can become President.**
